company.name: Alloovium
company.shortDescription: Alloovium is a document intelligence and contract compliance platform designed for commercial and infrastructure construction projects.
company.description: Alloovium processes project documentation, including contracts, drawings, specifications, and requests for information, to automate monthly reporting, progress claims, and quality assurance workflows. Users can query their document repositories for instant, cited information, perform automated compliance checks against contract clauses, and draft daily site records via voice inputs. The platform integrates directly with existing construction management tools, file storage systems, and communication channels to synchronize project data without requiring manual data migration.
